name: Topography Tracker
oracle_text:
When this creature enters, create a Map token. (It's an artifact with "{1}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: Target creature you control explores. Activate only as a sorcery.")
If a creature you control would explore, instead it explores, then it explores again.
blocked_sentences: If a creature you control would explore, instead it explores, then it explores again.

needs.what: a static replacement effect, scoped by an `affects` filter (creatures you control), that replaces each explore event (701.44) performed by a matching creature with that creature exploring twice in sequence -- read wherever explore happens (the explore op, Map tokens, other cards' triggers), with an explore_multiplier-style magnitude
needs.why_existing_wont_do: static_effects has replace_draw, replace_mill, replace_surveil, replace_proliferate, replace_counters and replace_token_creation, but nothing replaces an explore; the `explore` op only takes `objects`, and no `explores` trigger_event exists to fake it (a trigger would also not be a replacement and would recurse)
